narr: Showers and thunderstorms erupted across the Tennessee Valley on October 6th, repeatedly moving across Marshall County, which caused widespread flash flooding. Numerous roadways were washed out across Arab, and sadly, 2 fatalities occurred during this flood event (one of which was a child swept away in a vehicle).
ev: Flash Flooding was reported in the Owens Cross Roads community.
Flooding reported along Little Cove Road.
Creek over the road at Cave Spring Road and Highway 431.
Flooding in the Bristol Creek Subdivision in Owens Cross Roads.
Road washed out at 8th Avenue and Arab-Thompson Road NE.
Two feet of water over Eddy Scant Road.
Multiple reports of numerous roadways flooded across the city of Arab.
Hobbs Island under 4 feet of water near Vann Road.
Water flooded into a restaurant. Several cars in the area are flooded too.

Flash flooding overnight on October 6th caused enough damage to a culvert to make it unstable. This partially collapsed the road on the 3400 block of Old Highway 431 in the Owens Cross Roads area. This road was closed this morning for public safety.
Flash flood fatality occurred on Haynes Road in Arab. Vehicle swept away with child inside. 2 other occupants were able to escape.
Flash flood fatality occurred on Friendship Road. A woman's vehicle was swept away in the flood waters and her body was found the next morning.
